A crystal archipelago of island towers rising from a dark sea, each tower a translucent faceted pinnacle hundreds of meters tall, their bases submerged and their summits blazing with captured and refracted starlight.

A vaulted underground chamber supported by enormous crystal stalagmites and stalactites fused into floor-to-ceiling columns, each one translucent and multifaceted, the whole interior lit by light traveling through the crystal bedrock.
A fracture zone where the crystal crust has split and tilted, exposing enormous angled slabs of translucent mineral rising from the rift like the pages of a colossal open book, facets blazing.

A plain bristling with tilted shard-monoliths, each a translucent blade the height of a tower block, angled at wild degrees, their faceted edges glittering with refracted light in overlapping rainbow fans.

A frozen crystal sea of jagged waves locked mid-surge, each crest a translucent faceted wall meters thick, light tunneling through the glassy troughs and emerging fractured into spectrum columns above the stillness.

A colonnade of basalt-like crystal pillars stretching to the horizon, each hexagonal shaft translucent and faceted, tens of meters across, their flat tops glowing faintly where light enters from above and scatters downward.

An amphitheater ringed by gem-spires of immense scale, the curved walls built from fused translucent prisms, each faceted surface angling the surrounding light inward to pool in a blazing iridescent floor at center.

A spiral of crystal columns winding skyward, each shaft taller than the last, translucent and multi-faceted, the whole helix refracting light into a rotating aurora of color that climbs kilometers into the open sky.

A cathedral of fused quartz arches, each span hundreds of meters wide, translucent and ribbed with internal facets, light flooding through the curved walls and fracturing across the floor in shifting tessellated brilliance.

A field of giant floating crystal shards suspended in tiered drifts above the ground, each translucent and faceted slab the size of a stadium, slowly rotating, casting prismatic shadows kilometers long below.

A frozen crystal forest of branching mineral trees, each trunk and limb translucent and faceted, some specimens fifty meters tall, their canopies splitting light into overlapping colored veils that fill the spaces between them.

A ridge of colossal crystal fins rising from a flat plain, each fin a translucent faceted membrane hundreds of meters tall and razor-thin at the edge, light passing clean through them in warm amber sheets.

A crater filled entirely with interlocking crystal pyramids, each a translucent faceted tetrahedron the size of a building, packed so densely their edges fuse, the whole basin glowing like a cut gemstone from orbit.

A canyon floor grown over with a dense pavement of giant crystal lenses, each translucent and perfectly faceted dome the width of a house, focusing shafts of light downward into brilliant burning points below.

A towering crystal mesa with sheer translucent walls revealing layered internal strata, each stratum a different tint, the whole formation glowing from within as light enters the flat top and refracts down through every level.
